description: Move a post, or several, to trash (kept 30 days; undo restores them). Pass post_id, or post_ids for up to 50 posts: one confirm_token covers the whole list, so the person is asked once. A Reel and its Trial Reel go together. Doesn't remove anything already published on a network.

confirm_token.description: Token from a CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED response, sent after the user confirms.

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

post_ids.description: Several posts, deleted under one confirmation

name: post_delete
title: Delete posts
